milestones.title: M0: Repo And Workflow Bootstrap
milestones.description: Git workflow, labels, issue templates, issue backlog, and initial CI skeleton.

milestones.title: M1: Foundation And Control Plane
milestones.description: API, persistence, state machine, queue foundation, and tests.

milestones.title: M2: Render Pipeline Integration
milestones.description: Controlled adapters around current scripts and ComfyUI render flow.

milestones.title: M3: Factory UI Vertical Slice
milestones.description: Episode editor, text beats, validation, and render queue.

milestones.title: M4: Analytics And Recommendation Loop
milestones.description: TikTok snapshots, KPI comparisons, and recommendations.

milestones.title: M5: Production Hardening
milestones.description: Observability, deployment, backups, and integration test hardening.

issues.title: Epic: Backend Core And Persistence
issues.body:
## Goal
Create the FastAPI control plane and durable domain state for ContentFactory.

## Scope
Config, health, DB session, migrations, SQLAlchemy/Pydantic models, CRUD boundaries for Campaign, Character, Episode, Scene, VoiceLine, TextBeat, Asset, Export.

## Non-Goals
No real ComfyUI render execution in this epic.

## Acceptance Criteria
- API starts locally.
- Core models persist in dev DB.
- CRUD endpoints are covered by tests.
- Secrets remain outside DB.

issues.title: Epic: Job Queue And Render State
issues.body:
## Goal
Introduce worker-backed RenderJob and RenderStep execution with retry/cancel semantics.

## Scope
Queue setup, worker process, step state machine, structured step logs, retry policy, cancellation boundary.

## Acceptance Criteria
- RenderJob can be created and enqueued.
- Worker updates step state.
- Failed retryable steps can be retried without losing artifacts.

issues.title: Epic: Legacy Script And Provider Adapters
issues.body:
## Goal
Wrap existing generation scripts without changing creative behavior.

## Scope
Adapters for make_short.py, expand_ltx_workflow.py, add_elevenlabs_voice.py, add_voice.py, tt_analytics.py, track_snapshot.py.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Adapters expose typed inputs/outputs.
- Existing defaults are preserved.
- Logs and artifacts are captured.

issues.title: Epic: Narrative Overlay And Export Policy
issues.body:
## Goal
Make burned-in narrative text a first-class validated export requirement.

## Scope
TextBeat validation, safe-area policy, ffmpeg overlay provider, export metadata, no_text_experiment escape hatch.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Standard TikTok export fails without text starting by 0.3s.
- no_text_experiment is explicit and stored.
- Final MP4 has burned-in text metadata tracked.

issues.title: Epic: Frontend Factory UI
issues.body:
## Goal
Build the operator UI for campaign/episode creation, text beats, validation, and queue visibility.

## Scope
Dashboard, Campaign Lab, Episode Editor, Storyboard, Text Beats timeline, Render Queue.

## Acceptance Criteria
- User can create and edit an episode.
- UI validates text beats through backend.
- Queue shows job status and errors.

issues.title: Epic: Analytics And KPI Insights
issues.body:
## Goal
Persist TikTok analytics snapshots and produce retention-focused comparisons.

## Scope
TikTok scrape adapter, snapshot DB ingestion, export/video ID linking, campaign analytics board, recommendation cards.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Snapshots are queryable by campaign/export.
- Variants compare avg watch/full-watch/retention note.
- On-screen text policy is included in analysis.

issues.title: Epic: Test Harness And Delivery Workflow
issues.body:
## Goal
Keep the project reviewable and safe through tests, CI, and disciplined git workflow.

## Scope
pytest harness, fixtures, unit tests, GitHub issue/PR conventions, CI skeleton, optional nightly integration tests.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Unit tests run without GPU/TikTok.
- CI runs lint/tests for backend and frontend skeleton.
- Issues and PRs map to approved batches.

issues.title: Batch: Repository Workflow And Issue Backlog
issues.body:
## Goal
Initialize git workflow and owner-reviewable backlog.

## Tasks
- Add milestones/epics/batches document.
- Add GitHub issue templates.
- Add labels and issue backlog manifest.
- Add script to sync labels, milestones, and issues when credentials are available.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Backlog can be reviewed before implementation.
- Remote origin is configured.
- Issue sync is reproducible.

## Test Plan
- Validate JSON manifest.
- Run sync script in dry-run mode.

issues.title: Batch: Backend Skeleton And Health API
issues.body:
## Goal
Stabilize the FastAPI project skeleton.

## Tasks
- Finalize backend package layout.
- Add config and health checks.
- Add API router conventions.
- Add dependency placeholders for DB/worker.

## Acceptance Criteria
- API starts locally.
- GET /api/v1/health returns runtime config summary.
- No provider calls happen during startup.

## Test Plan
- Import app.
- Exercise health endpoint with TestClient.

issues.title: Batch: Core Domain Models And Migrations
issues.body:
## Goal
Introduce durable schema for factory records.

## Tasks
- Add SQLAlchemy setup and Alembic.
- Model Campaign, Character, Episode, Scene, VoiceLine, OnScreenTextBeat.
- Model Asset, RenderJob, RenderStep, Export, AnalyticsSnapshot.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Migrations create all core tables.
- Models have relationships and indexes for job/export lookup.

## Test Plan
- Migration smoke test on SQLite/Postgres dev DB.
- Repository unit tests.

issues.title: Batch: Episode CRUD And Text Beat Validation API
issues.body:
## Goal
Expose the first real editor-facing API surface.

## Tasks
- CRUD endpoints for Campaign and Episode.
- Bulk upsert for scenes, voice lines, text beats.
- Validate-export endpoint using server-side text policy.

## Acceptance Criteria
- UI can persist an episode draft.
- Standard TikTok export validation fails without first hook text.

## Test Plan
- API tests for valid/invalid text beats.
- CRUD tests for episode draft lifecycle.

issues.title: Batch: Render Job Queue Foundation
issues.body:
## Goal
Create queue-backed render job control without real rendering yet.

## Tasks
- Select and wire Redis/RQ or Celery.
- Add worker entrypoint.
- Add POST /episodes/{id}/render.
- Add GET/retry/cancel render job endpoints.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Job transitions queued -> running -> succeeded/failed in a fake task.
- Retry/cancel semantics are enforced.

## Test Plan
- State machine tests.
- Worker fake-task integration test.

issues.title: Batch: ComfyUI Client And Workflow Validation
issues.body:
## Goal
Build the factory-owned ComfyUI adapter inspired by comfyui-mcp.

## Tasks
- HTTP client for /prompt, /history, /queue, /object_info.
- Workflow validation for missing nodes, required inputs, broken links, model dropdown references.
- Queue/status polling helper.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Validation runs before submit.
- Comfy connection errors become structured provider errors.

## Test Plan
- Mock ComfyUI HTTP responses.
- Golden workflow validation fixtures.

issues.title: Batch: Legacy Render Script Adapters
issues.body:
## Goal
Wrap current generation scripts as typed provider adapters.

## Tasks
- Expand LTX workflow adapter.
- make_short pass-through adapter.
- ElevenLabs/F5 voice adapters.
- ffmpeg command builders for mux/overlay/concat.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Adapters preserve current defaults.
- Commands are inspectable before execution.
- Outputs are registered as artifacts.

## Test Plan
- Unit tests with mocked subprocess and HTTP.
- No GPU required.

issues.title: Batch: Artifact Manager And Lineage
issues.body:
## Goal
Track every generated file as a managed asset.

## Tasks
- Artifact root layout.
- Checksum and metadata capture.
- Parent/child lineage between keyframe, clip, audio, export, screenshot.
- Artifact lookup API.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Every render step output has an Asset record.
- Retry does not overwrite prior artifacts silently.

## Test Plan
- tmp_path storage tests.
- lineage repository tests.

issues.title: Batch: Frontend Episode Editor Vertical Slice
issues.body:
## Goal
Build the first usable operator flow.

## Tasks
- App shell and navigation.
- Campaign/Episode creation screens.
- Scene list editor.
- Text Beats editor with backend validation call.
- Render button wired to backend job endpoint.

## Acceptance Criteria
- User can create an episode draft and validate it.
- UI blocks render when backend returns text policy errors.

## Test Plan
- Typecheck/build.
- Component tests for validation states when test framework is added.

issues.title: Batch: Render Queue UI
issues.body:
## Goal
Make long-running jobs observable from the UI.

## Tasks
- Jobs table.
- Job details drawer.
- Step timeline and logs.
- Retry/cancel actions.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Operator sees active, failed, completed jobs.
- Failed step shows error code and hint.

## Test Plan
- Mock API states for queued/running/failed/completed.

issues.title: Batch: TikTok Analytics Ingestion
issues.body:
## Goal
Move TikTok analytics from CSV-only files into queryable product state.

## Tasks
- Adapter around tt_analytics.py.
- Snapshot parser and DB writer.
- Attach TikTok video ID to Export.
- Store scrape screenshot as artifact.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Snapshot records include avg watch, full-watch percent, retention note, views.
- Snapshot links to export/campaign.

## Test Plan
- Fixture tests for saved CSV/JSON.
- CDP scrape remains manual/integration-only.

issues.title: Batch: Recommendation Cards
issues.body:
## Goal
Generate actionable next-test recommendations from campaign variants.

## Tasks
- Compare variants by avg watch, full-watch percent, retention note.
- Include on-screen text metadata in analysis.
- Show recommendation cards in UI.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Recommendation includes reason, evidence, and suggested next hook/edit.

## Test Plan
- Deterministic scoring tests with fixtures.

issues.title: Batch: Production Hardening And Local Deployment
issues.body:
## Goal
Make the single-workstation deployment repeatable and recoverable.

## Tasks
- Docker Compose for API, worker, Redis, Postgres, frontend.
- Structured logs.
- Provider timeout/backoff policy.
- Backup/export runbook.
- Nightly integration test plan.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Local stack can be started and stopped from docs.
- Worker restart preserves job/artifact state.

## Test Plan
- Compose smoke test.
- Recovery runbook dry run.
